s0CA5DE.name: Ending: eggshell fragments and Yoshi helpers
summary: Code for the Yoshi egg-hatching ending scene (credits engine): scene stages 3 and 4, the fragment update/draw routine,
fixed-point motion helper, Mario-on-Yoshi setup. Object arrays at $0B05-$0B80: Y speed $0B05, Y subpixel $0B23, Y pos $0B41/$0B5F,
X speed $0B14, X subpixel $0B32, X pos $0B50/$0B6E (X-direction entries are the Y entries + $0F).
Slots 3-6 are four flying fragments (probably eggshell pieces); slots 7-13 are the seven eggs / hatched Yoshis.
Stage dispatch is by [$1442] (PtrsLong0CA1DE). Interpretation of the scene is partly guessed.

s0CA7B9.name: Table: tiles for 32x32 sprite
summary: Tile numbers for CODE_0CA821: 4 bytes per frame, 2 rows of (left, right).

s0CA7ED.name: Table: properties for 32x32 sprite
summary: OAM property bytes matching the tile table above, same layout.

s0CA821.name: Draw 32x32 sprite from 16x16 tiles
summary: Draws 2 rows of 2 large tiles (32x32 total) into OAM, using the tile and property tables at $0CA7B9/$0CA7ED.
Parameters: X: OAM offset, Y: frame index (4 bytes per frame), $00/$01: X position, $02: Y position.
Skips drawing if the X high byte is nonzero. Y >= $28 selects the upper OAM block (offset + $100).

s0CA8D1.name: Table: hatched Yoshi properties
summary: $0CA8D1: seven bytes $00-$60, no reference found (unused?). $0CA8D8: OAM properties (palette/flip) for the seven hatched Yoshis.

s0CA8DF.name: Draw eggs and hatched Yoshis
summary: Walks slots $0D..7. For each on-screen slot writes an OAM entry at [$02]: tile $86 for unhatched (bit in [$145A] clear),
tile $EA with a per-slot property from DATA_0CA8D8 once hatched. Reads positions from $0B50/$0B41. Large (16x16) tiles.

s0CA93A.name: Table: tiles for 6-tile sprite
summary: 4 frames x 6 tiles (first pair large, rest small).

s0CA99A.name: Table: frame offsets for 6-tile sprite
summary: Offset of each frame in the 6-tile tables: 0, 6, 12, 18.

s0CA99E.name: Draw 6-tile animated sprite
summary: Draws two 16x16 tiles on top and four 8x8 tiles below, offsets/tiles/props from the tables at $0CA93A-$0CA982.
Parameters: Y: frame number * 4, X: OAM offset, $00/$02: X/Y position.

s0CAA0B.name: Table: tiles and properties for 16x32 sprite

s0CAA15.name: Draw 16x32 sprite from two tiles
summary: Two stacked 16x16 tiles (second at Y + $10).
Parameters: Y: tile pair offset, X: OAM offset, $0E: property pair index, $00/$02: X/Y position.

s0CAA53.name: Data: static picture sprite records
summary: 35 four-byte OAM records (X, Y, tile, property) drawn by CODE_0CAADF. Rows below are decoded; #n = record number.

s0CAADF.name: Draw static 35-sprite picture; screen wipe
summary: CODE_0CAADF (JSL from the credits-screen setup at $00967F) copies the 35 records into OAM as large sprites.
CODE_0CAB13 is a JSL wrapper for CODE_0CAB1F, the screen wipe: it steps [$1B89] by 2 toward $0 or $E0, advances the scene
phase [$1928] and loads its palette when the wipe ends, and builds a per-scanline window table at $04A0 for HDMA channel 7.

s0CAB1B.name: Table: wipe step and end values
summary: $0CAB1B: step -2 / +2. $0CAB1D: end values $00 / $E0.

s0CAB1F.name: Screen wipe update (window HDMA)
summary: Updates [$1B89] (wipe size) by [DATA_0CAB1B+X], rebuilds the window HDMA tables ($04A0/$057E, 112 lines each half).
On reaching $E0 it flips the direction, advances [$1928] and loads the next palette (CODE_0CABB2); phase >= 6 advances the game mode.
Parameters: X: [$1B88] direction, Y: [$1928] scene phase. Writes $41, $43, $44, $212E/$212F, $0D9F (HDMA channel 7).

s0CAB9C.name: Table: palette selection per scene phase
summary: $0CAB9C: palette block offsets. $0CABA4: backdrop color index per phase. $0CABAB: block number per phase.

s0CABB2.name: Load scene phase palette
summary: Builds two palette-upload entries at $0682/$0690 (length $0C, CGRAM $02/$12, six colors each) from $00:B0B0+block, and
sets color 0 in the palette buffer ($0701) from $00:B0A0. Parameters: [$1928]: scene phase.

s0CAC29.name: Data: credits scene layer 1 object streams
summary: 13 streams (one per credits scene, pointers at $0CAD58). Each: 5-byte level header (see LEVEL_PIPELINE_NOTES), 3-byte objects, $FF end.

s0CAD58.name: Pointer table: layer 1 stream per scene
summary: 13 words, bank $0C. Read by CODE_0CAD8C into $65/$66.

s0CAD72.name: Pointer table: layer 2 data per scene
summary: 13 words, bank $0C. Read by CODE_0CAD8C into $68/$69.

s0CAD8C.name: Set credits scene layer data pointers
summary: Increments the scene number [$1DE9], then sets the layer 1 pointer $65-$67 (bank $0C) and layer 2 pointer $68-$6A.
Layer 2 bank byte is $FF except for scene 12 ($0C). Called from the credits setup at $0095CA.

s0CADB5.name: Table: window edge per credits scene
summary: 13 bytes, probably the window edge X written to HDMA table entries at $04A3 etc. (right edge = $88 - value).

s0CADC2.name: Table: layer 2 Y position per scene
summary: 13 words, copied to [$20] by the scene setup that follows this table.

s0CADDC.name: Pointer table: scene data in bank 0D
summary: 13 words pointing into bank $0D (copied as VRAM stripe data into $7F837D until $FFFF).
